listing.name: F-Zero / F-Zero Recomp (craigshaw)
listing.summary: Explore F-Zero / F-Zero Recomp (craigshaw) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Install or keep your existing copy
steps.instruction: Install uses the official portable runtime with updates managed by Portcove. Installation options also retain a non-owning route for an existing or customized copy.

steps.title: Start with your original game
steps.instruction: On first Play, select your own F-Zero USA ROM and press Play in the launcher. The package includes its native runtime and does not require generating or compiling game code. The launcher remembers the selected ROM path.

steps.title: Keep your progress
steps.instruction: Settings, key bindings, the remembered ROM path, default saves and screenshots live beside fzero_recomp.exe and are declared for compatible updates and backup. The optional fzero_usa_reference.sfc original file is retained if supplied. A ROM selected elsewhere and a custom save folder remain external and outside backups. Runtime rollback carries current declared data; it does not rewind saves.
